ideas.pitch: An autonomous payload drop mechanism using downward-facing computer vision and real-time GPS correction to hit target zones within 10cm accuracy during mission flight rounds.
ideas.title: PrecisionDrop UAV Payload Delivery System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles Round 2 mission flight requirements like payload drop, combining hardware actuation with reliable on-board CV matching the winning robotics rover pattern.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight radio-frequency mesh telemetry relay that maintains continuous bidirectional drone tracking and emergency kill-switch capability even in GPS-denied or RF-jammed environments.
ideas.title: AeroSync Offline Mesh Telemetry
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical safety and compliance inspection criteria by providing a robust backup communication link in case of primary telemetry loss.

ideas.pitch: An automated vision and sensor checklist system that inspects propeller balance, motor health, and battery voltage before flight, generating an instant compliance report for Round 1 technical inspection.
ideas.title: UAV Pre-Flight Airworthiness Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Streamlines Round 1 Technical & Safety Inspection, impressing judges with rigorous adherence to safety norms and airworthiness verification.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed mapping pipeline that detects obstacles and constructs a 2D orthomosaic grid in real-time onboard the UAV without requiring an active cloud internet connection.
ideas.title: Autonomous Mapping and Hazard Detection Drone
ideas.why_it_could_win: Executes complex mapping mission tasks entirely offline at the edge, demonstrating advanced autonomous navigation that stands out during the documentation and viva round.

ideas.pitch: An independent hardware safety cutoff module that monitors real-time GPS coordinates and automatically cuts motor power if the UAV drifts outside the designated flight zone boundary.
ideas.title: GeoFence Guardian Flight Limiter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly enforces the strict safety regulation that flights must remain within the designated flight zone and protects against runaway crashes during flight rounds.
